name: Uncle and His Friend
source:
Koa dislikes children. One day, he's put in a situation where he has to take care of his niece Lani. Not knowing what to do, he asks his best friend Daiki for help. Together, the two friends co-parent the little girl.  Lani grows fond of Daiki because of his gentle manners but dislikes Koa due to his standoffish attitude toward her.  Will the uncle and niece ever get along? Daiki is there to help.

[From [url=https://chanimk.itch.io/uncle-and-his-friend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Koa不喜欢孩子。有一天，他不得不照顾他的侄女拉尼。他不知道该怎么办，于是向最好的朋友大树寻求帮助。两个朋友共同抚养这个小女孩。拉尼因为大树的温柔举止而喜欢他，但因为他对她的态度冷淡而不喜欢科阿。叔叔和侄女能和睦相处吗？Daiki随时为你提供帮助。

[来自[url=https://chanimk.itch.io/uncle-and-his-friend]itch.io[/url]]
